title: GistUI action envelope
description: What a renderer and runtime report to the host (GistUI Format 1.0, section 20.3). type selects the shape. A host ignores an envelope whose type it does not know.

nodeId.description: Id of the node the person acted on, or the node or statement concerned (section 13.3).

send.description: Text for the assistant, from @send or from a component whose purpose is to send text. Produced by the UI, not typed by the person (section 23.7).

open.description: A link to open. The URL has passed the scheme check of section 23.3.

emit.description: A custom event for the host, from @emit(name, payload).

payload.description: Any JSON value; null when @emit had no second argument.

submit.description: A form was submitted, or a draft was saved (partial).

form.description: The form's name in the program.

values.description: Field name to value. Empty optional fields are left out.

partial.description: True for a draft saved without validation.

formId.description: A stable id for the form: the one the program gave, or one derived from its fields.

submissionId.description: Unique for each submission. Usable as an idempotency key.

step.description: For a form in steps: where the person was.

fields.description: Field descriptions: name, label, component, type, rules.

message.description: A short text summary a chat host can pass to a model. Produced by the UI (section 23.7).

value.description: The new value: any JSON value.

tool.description: A tool is about to be called (section 19.3). The host can refuse the call.

kind.description: query: the UI called it by itself. mutation: a gesture of the person ran it.
